prompt: Explain why increasing sample size reduces random error but does not automatically remove bias.

prompt: Explain why a map can distort the size or shape of countries.

prompt: Explain why photosynthesis is important for most ecosystems.

prompt: Explain why electric power grids need supply and demand to stay balanced.

prompt: Explain why inflation reduces purchasing power.
model_response: Because rising prices mean each unit of currency buys fewer goods and services

prompt: Explain why eyewitness testimony can be unreliable.
